text: Danny is serving a sentence; Lena is the only one who makes the drive to visit him.
Their mother's mind is going; she is in a home and does not always know where she is.
Their mother always loved Danny best; Lena was the reliable one, taken for granted.
This week, for the first time, their mother did not ask after Danny; she has stopped saying his name.
Every visit Lena tells Danny their mam sends her love and was asking after him — a kindness that is no longer true.
